rows.title: SIDE24 public coefficient viewer notebook (NON-CERTIFYING display of published endpoints)
rows.reason: Cell 1 fetches Math-@9d7b6802424fb4715b31999066aafca8ee2f3cca:coefficients/side24_v1/ENCLOSURE.json and refuses it unless it is 1090 bytes with SHA-256 72b6cd92... and scientific_acceptance false. Cell 2 keeps the published decimal endpoint strings, checks 0 < lower < upper, and prints them; Decimal is used only for a display midpoint. Cell 4 draws an optional Matplotlib chart of float midpoints, labelled NON-CERTIFYING. Nothing is computed beyond the published numbers, so the notebook states no mathematics of its own.
